title: IBC does not adequately account for interests of MSMEs, small operational creditors: Supreme Court
description: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) does not adequately account for the interests of small operational creditors, including Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), the Supreme Court opined recently [Tata Steel Limited v. Varsha].A Bench of Justices Manoj Misra and Manmohan said that such creditors stand significantly disenfranchised under the present insolvency framework.“The Code does not adequately account for the position of small operational creditors, including MSMEs and statutory
